dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin. A coin invented as a joke. Has gone from $ 0.003 to $ 0.61 in 5 months. That’s an appreciation of 200x. 

If you’d put in R 1 million in November 2020 you’d have R 200 million in May 2021. https://t.co/EKAG3BXeCr

Bitcoin price likely to dump over this latest tweet. But in a few months time if Musk doesn’t deliver on Dogecoin (and that’s a big, big ask) then the cryptosphere will laugh off Musk and Bitcoin will bounce to 200k and then upwards and onwards. https://t.co/vgLuF3ajHL
